text:
ana: Quick follow-up from the postmortem thread  we need firm owners, Jira links, and explicit handoffs for the repeated KV cache evictions. Short ask: assign tickets, add ACs, and confirm handoffs for dashboards/playbooks.

matt: I'll take the short-term eviction tweak + canary. Will post canary runbook and results here.

raj: I can own the deeper investigation and tenant heatmaps.

sophie: I'll own regression tests in Optimize and add a detector for eviction anomalies.

kim: I'll take dashboard/alert updates and make sure oncall runbooks link to them.

jira-bot: Created RW-3840: "Short-term eviction tweak + canary" assigned to matt, due 2026-03-30. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RW-3840

jira-bot: Created RW-3841: "Investigation - KV eviction storms" assigned to raj, due 2026-04-10. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RW-3841

jira-bot: Created RW-3842: "Dashboards & alerts for cache eviction" assigned to kim, due 2026-03-31. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RW-3842

jira-bot: Created RW-3843: "Optimize regression probe for eviction anomalies" assigned to sophie, due 2026-04-20. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RW-3843

matt: Canary plan (short): patch eviction_threshold -> 0.78, restart cache-workers, monitor eviction_rate and p95 for 30m. Command: 
```
kubectl -n inference patch cm cache-config --patch '{"data":{"eviction_threshold":"0.78"}}' && kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/cache-workers
```

oncall-bot: Canary scheduled 2026-03-24T02:45:00Z; alert window 30m.

ana: (typo) ana: Proposed RACI: R=Raj, A=Ana, C=Eng-SRE (Matt/Kim), I=Product (Oliver), S=Support (Sophie). Confirm.

oliver-pm: I'll be I and own coordination with infra-planning; will review RW-3841 and RW-3840.

matt: ACs for RW-3840: 1) eviction_rate < 3/min during 2x baseline traffic in canary window, 2) p95 latency change <= 5%, 3) no increase in error-rate.

raj: RW-3841 ACs: reproduce eviction signature in traces, identify whether tenant or job is root cause, and recommend immediate mitigations.

kim: RW-3842 ACs: new dashboard tile for per-tenant eviction rate, alert when total eviction_rate > 5/min for 5m, doc link in playbook.

sophie: RW-3843 ACs: Optimize probe triggers on >3/min eviction bursts and posts regression alert to postmortem board.

matt: Pairing session with Raj tomorrow 09:00 PST to go over traces. I'll attach canary logs to RW-3840 after run.

ana: Also creating RW-3844 for "Batch job scheduling review" assigned to Oliver to see if nightly jobs coincide with spikes. Due 2026-04-07.

jira-bot: RW-3844 created and assigned to oliver-pm.

matt: I'll report back here after canary. Thanks everyone ":thumbsup:"

ana: Thanks team. We'll reconvene after canary + initial investigation findings.
